prompt: This modern living room features a large, light grey curved sectional sofa adorned with a textured throw blanket, resting on a softly patterned circular rug. Behind the sofa, a cream-colored paneled wall displays a gallery of three abstract art prints in neutral tones. To the left, sheer grey curtains cover floor-to-ceiling windows looking out onto a lush green landscape, accompanied by vibrant potted plants and a light wood column. The space is illuminated by linear recessed ceiling lights set within a wood-accented drop ceiling, complementing the sleek light grey tiled flooring that extends down an adjacent hallway.

This modern living room features a sleek black reclining sofa positioned across from a large wall-mounted television and a dark grey media console. Glossy white tile floors are anchored by a textured grey area rug, an elongated white coffee table, and a minimalist black ottoman. The ceiling is equipped with flush modern track lighting that brightly illuminates the space. At the far end, a large window with sheer white curtains offers expansive landscape views, while a compact built-in laundry nook is efficiently tucked into the adjacent left corner.

This spacious basement features beige carpeting and light beige walls accented with a distinctive wood-paneled wainscoting. Three flush-mount dome lights illuminate the main area, highlighting a large brown reclining sofa positioned centrally. Along the back wall, a wooden shelving unit holds various toys and items, accompanied by a child's wooden rocking horse nearby. In the background, a dark wooden bookcase and a small desk area suggest a partial workspace or study nook. A dark wood end table sits beside the sofa, and the room is accessed through a white paneled door from a gray hallway.

This is the exterior entrance of a striking modern building characterized by a massive, multi-story glass curtain wall facade supported by a visible steel grid structure. The entrance area features multiple sets of glass double doors, notably marked with the number "9," set within opaque white paneled sections at the base. The ground is paved with reddish-brown tiles, and a simple metal trash receptacle stands near the doors. A traffic signal with a "One Way" sign is prominent in the foreground, suggesting an urban street corner location. Small landscaping beds with flowers and young trees line the walkway, adding a touch of greenery to the sleek, industrial architecture.
